 Marine Corps Marathon 2026 road closures in DC, Arlington 
 Here's what to know if you're getting around the D.C. area this weekend. 
 By Gina Cook • 
 Published October 23, 2026 • 
 Updated on October 23, 2026 at 4:19 pm 
 BOOKMARKER 
 NBC Universal, Inc. 
 The 51st Marine Corps Marathon is here! News4’s Transportation Reporter Adam Tuss breaks down all of the road closures and restrictions you can expect this Sunday.
 Many roads will be closed in D.C. and Arlington, Virginia, this weekend for the 51st annual Marine Corps Marathon.
 Most of the parking restrictions and street closures will be from early Sunday morning through Sunday evening.
 Stream NBC4 newscasts for free right here, right now.

 2026 Marine Corps Marathon course map
 Here's a complete list:
 Marine Corps Marathon road closures in D.C.
 The Metropolitan Police Department said the following streets will be posted as Emergency No Parking from 2 a.m. to 2 p.m. Sunday:
 3rd Street from Constitution Avenue NW to Independence Avenue SW
 7th Street from Constitution Avenue NW to Independence Avenue SW
 14th Street from Constitution Avenue NW to Independence Avenue SW
 M Street from Canal Road to Wisconsin Avenue NW
 Canal Road from Arizona Avenue to Foxhall Road NW
 Wisconsin Avenue from M Street to K Street NW
 K Street from 27th Street to Wisconsin Avenue NW
 Madison Drive from 3rd Street to 15th Street NW
 Jefferson Drive from 3rd Street to 15th Street SW
 Independence Avenue from 23rd Street to 12th Street SW
 These streets will be closed to vehicle traffic from about 5:30 a.m. to 3 p.m. Sunday:
 3rd Street from Constitution Avenue NW to Independence Avenue SW
 7th Street from Constitution Avenue NW to Independence Avenue SW
 14th Street from Constitution Avenue NW to Independence Avenue SW
 M Street from Canal Road to Wisconsin Avenue NW
 Canal Road from Arizona Avenue to Foxhall Road NW

 Jefferson Drive from 3rd Street to 15th Street SW
 Independence Avenue from 23rd Street to 12th Street SW

 HOV lanes of the 14th Street Bridge
 Key Bridge
 Memorial Bridge
 D.C. police said any of the closures or listed times could change. Police said they'll post updates and timely information on X .

 Marine Corps Marathon Arlington road closures
 Arlington County police advised drivers and residents that numerous roads will be closed Sunday for the race.
 The following roads will be closed from about 3 a.m. until 6 p.m.:

 These roads will be closed from about 6 a.m. until 5 p.m.

 18th Street S. from S. Bell Street to Crystal Drive

 I-395 South exit 10A to Boundary Channel Drive
 From Saturday, Oct. 24 starting about 4 p.m., southbound Route 110 will be closed from Washington Boulevard to Route 1 and will reopen at 5 p.m. on Sunday, Oct. 25.
 Road reopening times are approximate and will depend on course cleanup efforts, Arlington County police said. Police said they could close other roads not listed above in the interest of public safety.
